component-o.description-s: 2.5-5.5 V input, 2 A, 1.5 MHz synchronous step-down converter, adjustable output 0.6 V to VIN, SOT-23-5

cfgpins-ao.1c: EN high (VIH 1.2 V max) enables, do not leave floating: tied to VIN

cfgpins-ao.5c: VFB 0.6 V; VOUT = 0.6 V x (1 + R1/R2): 300k / 150k gives the row's 1.8 V (TI typical application R1, R2 0603 1 %; C3 feed-forward optional)

load_regulation_source-o.derived: CCM portion 1.0 -> 1.994 A: VOUT 1.8 V +0.0005 % -> -0.3332 % = 6.01 mV / 0.994 A = 6.04 mV/A (matches the record's VOUT 1.8 V, so it is the klayout key); VOUT 3.3 V +0.0005 % -> -0.0079 % = 0.28 mV / 0.994 A = 0.28 mV/A (at the plot resolution; the curve is flat within +/-0.02 %). Below ~0.8 A the curve is the PFM offset
